name: Renewable Energy
one_liner: Generating power from solar, wind, storage and other low-carbon sources, where economics are dominated by upfront capital and financing costs rather than fuel.
how_it_makes_money: Developers originate projects and sell them or hold them to earn power revenue. Owner-operators sell electricity under long-term power purchase agreements (PPAs) with utilities or corporates, or into wholesale markets, and monetize tax credits. Equipment makers sell panels, turbines, inverters and batteries, while installers earn margins on residential and commercial systems.
revenue_formula: Project revenue = installed capacity (MW) × capacity factor × 8,760 hours × PPA or market price per MWh
Manufacturer revenue = units shipped (GW) × average selling price per watt
Residential solar revenue = installs × system size (kW) × price per watt
cost_structure: Capital cost of equipment: panels, turbines, batteries, inverters
Balance of system and construction: labor, racking, civil works
Interconnection and grid upgrades: increasingly costly and slow
Financing costs: interest and tax equity returns, very sensitive to interest rates
Operations and maintenance: relatively small, no fuel cost
margins: Operating assets under long-term PPAs earn stable, utility-like returns, while manufacturers and developers see thinner, more volatile margins. Interest rates, equipment prices, capacity factor and policy incentives drive the spread.

key_metrics.name: Levelized cost of energy (LCOE)
key_metrics.what: Lifetime cost per MWh of a project, used to compare technologies.

key_metrics.name: Capacity factor
key_metrics.what: Actual output versus maximum possible; drives revenue per MW installed.

key_metrics.name: PPA price ($/MWh)
key_metrics.what: Contracted sale price that anchors project revenue.

key_metrics.name: Cost per watt ($/W)
key_metrics.what: Installed cost, the key input for project economics.

key_metrics.name: Development pipeline (GW)
key_metrics.what: Projects in queue, signaling future growth.

key_metrics.name: Curtailment rate
key_metrics.what: Share of potential output wasted due to grid limits or oversupply.
